chunks.title: Ganges View Heritage Hotel — Property Overview
chunks.text: Ganges View Heritage Hotel is a 4-star boutique property on Assi Ghat, Varanasi. The hotel blends colonial architecture with modern comfort, targeting cultural travellers and pilgrims.

chunks.title: Ganges View Heritage Hotel — Property Overview
chunks.text: modern comfort, targeting cultural travellers and pilgrims. Brand positioning emphasizes riverside serenity, curated heritage walks, and locally sourced cuisine. Star rating: 4. Ambiance: tranquil, spiritual, refined.

chunks.title: Sacred Lotus Boutique Inn — Overview
chunks.text: Sacred Lotus Boutique Inn is a 3-star design-led inn near Godowlia Chowk. Compact rooms, artisan decor, and a rooftop cafe define the experience. Positioned for budget-conscious explorers seeking authentic neighbourhood stays.

chunks.title: Kashi Riverside Resort — Overview
chunks.text: Kashi Riverside Resort is a 5-star resort on the Ganges with private ghats and spa villas. Premium leisure positioning for honeymoons and wellness retreats. Star rating: 5.

chunks.title: The Marina Grand — Beach Resort Overview
chunks.text: The Marina Grand is a 4-star beachfront resort in Goa, 50 metres from Calangute Beach. Family-friendly positioning with kids club and sea-view balconies. Ambiance: coastal, vibrant.

chunks.title: Sunset Bay Beach Hotel — Overview
chunks.text: Sunset Bay Beach Hotel is a 3-star property in South Goa with direct beach access. Known for sunset views and relaxed backpacker-luxe atmosphere.

chunks.title: Royal Varuna Palace — Overview
chunks.text: Royal Varuna Palace is a 5-star palace hotel near Varanasi Cantonment. Heritage luxury brand with banquet halls and royal suites for destination weddings.

chunks.title: City Centre Metro Hotel — Overview
chunks.text: City Centre Metro Hotel is a 3-star business hotel linked to Varanasi City metro station. Efficient, modern, aimed at corporate travellers and conference delegates.

chunks.title: Himalayan Retreat Lodge — Overview
chunks.text: Himalayan Retreat Lodge is a 4-star eco-lodge in Rishikesh with mountain views. Adventure and yoga positioning for nature-focused guests.

chunks.title: Hotel X Residency — Overview
chunks.text: Hotel X Residency is a 4-star business hotel in central Varanasi near the railway station. Known for reliable service, meeting rooms, and express check-in for corporate guests.

chunks.title: Ganges View — Amenities
chunks.text: Amenities include complimentary high-speed WiFi in all rooms and public areas. Guests receive a complimentary buffet breakfast daily from 6:30 to 10:00 AM in the ghat-view dining room.

chunks.title: Ganges View — Amenities
chunks.text: st daily from 6:30 to 10:00 AM in the ghat-view dining room. Additional facilities: riverside yoga deck, Ayurvedic spa, 24-hour concierge, in-room tea station, and laundry service. Parking is available on request.

chunks.title: Sacred Lotus — Amenities
chunks.text: Free WiFi throughout the property. Breakfast is available at the rooftop cafe for an additional charge (not complimentary). No spa; small fitness corner.

chunks.title: Kashi Riverside — Amenities
chunks.text: Complimentary WiFi, complimentary breakfast buffet, infinity pool, full-service spa, gym, private ghat access, and fine-dining restaurant.

chunks.title: Marina Grand — Amenities
chunks.text: Free WiFi, complimentary breakfast for all room categories, beach cabanas, outdoor pool, kids club, and seafood grill.

chunks.title: City Centre Metro — Amenities
chunks.text: Complimentary WiFi in lobby only; in-room WiFi is paid. Continental breakfast included with executive rooms only. Business centre and gym on site.

chunks.title: Sunset Bay — Amenities
chunks.text: Free WiFi in rooms and beach area. Complimentary light breakfast (fruit, bread, tea). Beach loungers and water sports desk.

chunks.title: Hotel X — Amenities
chunks.text: High-speed WiFi complimentary in all rooms. Buffet breakfast included with standard booking. Fitness centre, laundry, and airport shuttle (paid).

chunks.title: Review — Ganges View (Positive)
chunks.text: Rating: 4.5/5. 'Stunning ghat views and attentive staff. Breakfast spread was excellent. WiFi worked well for remote work.' Priya M., March 2025.

chunks.title: Review — Sacred Lotus (Neutral)
chunks.text: Rating: 3.5/5. 'Charming rooms but breakfast is overpriced. WiFi dropped in the evening.' James L., January 2025.

chunks.title: Review — Marina Grand (Excellent)
chunks.text: Rating: 4.9/5. 'Excellent beach location steps from the sand. Kids loved the pool. Outstanding reviews for cleanliness and breakfast. Best beach hotel we have stayed in.' Anita & Rahul K., February 2025.

chunks.title: Review — Sunset Bay (Positive)
chunks.text: Rating: 4.2/5. 'Great value near the beach. Simple breakfast but fresh. Friendly staff.' Marco T., December 2024.

chunks.title: Review — Kashi Riverside (Positive)
chunks.text: Rating: 4.7/5. 'Luxurious spa and flawless service. Worth the premium price.' Elena S., April 2025.

chunks.title: Review — City Centre (Negative)
chunks.text: Rating: 2.8/5. 'Noisy rooms facing the metro. Paid WiFi frustrating. Breakfast only for executives.' David P., November 2024.

chunks.title: Review — Royal Varuna (Positive)
chunks.text: Rating: 4.6/5. 'Palatial rooms and grand weddings venue. Food was exceptional.' Meera J., October 2024.

chunks.title: Review — Hotel X (Neutral)
chunks.text: Rating: 3.9/5. 'Solid business hotel. Good WiFi and breakfast. Nothing exceptional but reliable.' Sanjay R., March 2025.

chunks.title: Review — Marina Grand (Negative detail)
chunks.text: Rating: 3.8/5. 'Beach is crowded in peak season but hotel itself is excellent. Would still recommend for families.' Chris W., January 2025.

chunks.title: Review — Himalayan Retreat
chunks.text: Rating: 4.4/5. 'Peaceful mountain stay. Yoga sessions at sunrise were highlight.' Nina F., February 2025.

chunks.title: Hotel X Residency — Cancellation Policy
chunks.text: Cancellation policy for Hotel X Residency: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before check-in. Cancellations within 48 hours incur one night charge. No-shows are charged 100% of the booking. Refunds processed within 7 business days to the original payment method.

chunks.title: Ganges View — Policies
chunks.text: Check-in 2:00 PM, check-out 11:00 AM. Cancellation: free until 72 hours prior; 50% charge within 72 hours. Pets not allowed. Government photo ID required at check-in.

chunks.title: Marina Grand — Policies
chunks.text: Check-in 3:00 PM, check-out 12:00 PM. Flexible cancellation until 24 hours before arrival. Pet-friendly rooms available on request (surcharge applies). Passport or Aadhaar required.

chunks.title: Kashi Riverside — Policies
chunks.text: Check-in 2:00 PM. Non-refundable rate available at 15% discount. Standard rate: cancel 7 days prior for full refund. No pets.

chunks.title: Sacred Lotus — Policies
chunks.text: Check-in 1:00 PM, check-out 10:00 AM. Cancellation within 24 hours: first night charged. Small pets under 10 kg allowed with prior approval.

chunks.title: City Centre Metro — Policies
chunks.text: Check-in 12:00 PM. Corporate bookings: 24-hour cancellation window. Leisure bookings: 48-hour free cancellation. Valid ID mandatory.

chunks.title: Sunset Bay — Policies
chunks.text: Check-in 2:00 PM. Free cancellation up to 5 days before stay during monsoon season; otherwise 3 days prior. Refunds via UPI or card within 10 days.

chunks.title: Marina Grand — Location
chunks.text: Located at Calangute Beach, Goa 50 metres from the main beach entrance. Nearby: Baga Beach (2 km), Saturday Night Market (1.5 km). Goa International Airport 40 km (approx. 75 min by taxi).

chunks.title: Sunset Bay — Location
chunks.text: South Goa, Palolem area beachfront road, 100 m to Palolem Beach. Quiet neighbourhood, dolphin-watching boats nearby.

chunks.title: Ganges View — Location
chunks.text: Assi Ghat, Varanasi 500 m from Assi Ghat steps, 4 km from Varanasi Junction railway station. Near: Banaras Hindu University (3 km), local boat jetty (200 m).

chunks.title: Hotel X — Location
chunks.text: Cantonment area, Varanasi 1.2 km from Varanasi Junction, 45 min from Lal Bahadur Shastri Airport. Auto-rickshaw stand outside the hotel.

chunks.title: Kashi Riverside — Location
chunks.text: Riverside Road, Varanasi private ghat access, 6 km from city centre. Temple circuit tours depart from the hotel jetty.

chunks.title: City Centre Metro — Location
chunks.text: Connected to Varanasi City Metro Station (Exit B). 2 km from Godowlia market, 15 min metro to Assi Ghat.

chunks.title: Sacred Lotus — Location
chunks.text: Godowlia Chowk, old city Varanasi walking distance to Kashi Vishwanath corridor (15 min). Narrow lanes; hotel offers golf-cart pickup from main road.
